name: Handover is published, acknowledged by the recipient and receipted
description: Owner publishes a handover to Leo; Leo acknowledges through the one-use role link; both see the receipt.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /demo in a fresh browser context and wait until the page heading 'Today' is shown
Type 'TS handover: morning medication and Thursday ride' in the handover note field
Click 'Publish for review' and confirm publishing in the dialog if one appears
Verify the handover status shows 'Awaiting acceptance'
Open 'Sample controls' and click 'Open recipient role'
Open the 'Continue as Leo in a separate tab' link and continue in the page that opens
Open the handover that is awaiting Leo's review
Tick the review confirmation checkbox, then click 'Acknowledge only'
Verify a receipt starting with 'Accepted' and a date is shown
Verify the text 'Your accepted handover is saved.' is shown
